name: sidebar-organizer
description: Organize desktop projects and chats by verified source while preserving pins and project membership.

interface.longDescription: On-demand source-based filing for the Codex desktop sidebar. Preserves pinned items, project membership, and existing manual groups. Reports limited history coverage. Requires native desktop sidebar tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $organize-sidebar to organize my desktop projects and chats by source, preserving pins and project membership.
